subject: Match legacy zero-vector angles in archery friendly-fire checks
description: The current linux2 Profile_002 Savegame_010 replay-003 representative advanced past its stale animation frontier and diverged after frame 35207 when Soldier124 fell back to bow observation instead of selecting PC243 as a shot target. All target/range/profile inputs matched. A coincident ally Soldier125 remained in the live us-list. Original SBGeoVector2D::Angle handles determinant zero explicitly and returns PI when the dot product is non-positive, including the zero vector. Rust used atan2(0,0), returned zero, and falsely aligned the coincident ally with PC243, rejecting the shot as friendly fire. Archery target/friend angles now use the exact legacy determinant/dot branch, including its signed nonzero cases. Focused tests cover the coincident angle and friendly-fire admission. cargo fmt is clean. The representative and both task-36 schema-14 replay-009 controls match exact EOF.
